retrievalProfile.description: A theatrical composition featuring a central showman figure framed by ornate, arched fairground typography and a twilight carnival background.
excludeWhen: daylight outdoor scenes without artificial lighting

recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a man in a waistcoat and hat, tipping his brim, set against a twilight fairground with a glowing carousel and Ferris wheel. The top is dominated by a large, arched, multi-colored title treatment with Victorian flourishes, while the bottom is anchored by a red ribbon banner.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure acts as the bridge between the top title and bottom banner
Warm carnival lights contrast against the cool blue twilight sky
Arched typography mimics the curve of the Ferris wheel and carousel tops
Symmetrical layout with the subject centered horizontally
coreInvariants: Twilight blue to orange gradient sky
Glowing bokeh effect on carnival structures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, centered, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, colorful 'FUN OF THE FAIR' title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the subject's face and hand, then follows the body down to the bottom banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the composition is dense with fairground elements and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep twilight blue sky and dark waistcoat providing a stable base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and orange carnival lights creating warmth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and gold in the banners and typography for theatrical flair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (banners/type) against a more naturalistic but high-contrast photographic background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Victorian slab serif and condensed block serifs
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a heavy slab serif with a vertical gradient and thick 3D extrusion
Secondary text is housed within curved ribbon banners
Ornate scrollwork flourishes extend from the main title block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are warped to follow a convex arch
Internal inline detailing within the larger glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact decorative display type paired with legible condensed block serifs for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Victorian woodblock slab serif aesthetic
Provides the condensed western/fairground feel for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a twilight fairground scene with a glowing carousel on the left and a large Ferris wheel on the right. Center a man in a black hat and waistcoat tipping his hat. Leave the top and bottom areas clear for graphic overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched Victorian-style title at the top with red and gold outlines and a yellow-to-blue gradient fill. Add a red ribbon banner at the bottom with white condensed slab serif text.

verificationChecks: Are there ribbon banners at the top and bottom?
Does the color palette include red, gold, and twilight blue?
Is the typography Victorian in style?

adjustableVariables: Specific fairground attractions in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is correctly warped to the banners
Ensure the 3D extrusion on the title looks consistent
Verify the subject is centered and well-lit
Confirm the background bokeh doesn't distract from the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Theatrical Showman Layout = (Arched Victorian Display Type + Ribbon Banners) * (Twilight Carnival Background + Central Portrait)
